_comment: Tool-selection accuracy set (ROADMAP L5). Each case: a natural-language task a user/AI might describe, and the set of tool names that would be a CORRECT pick. The harness calls recommend_tool(query) and checks whether a correct tool appears in the top-1 and top-3. HONEST framing: recommend_tool is a keyword-overlap heuristic (see profiles.py) — NOT a model. This set measures how well that heuristic maps intent→tool, and it deliberately keeps realistic queries that MISS so the number reflects reality (describe_tool / list_capabilities are the fallbacks when it misses).

cases.query: verify that a derivative claim is correct
check whether two algebraic expressions are equal
find a counterexample to an inequality that may be false
cases.note: known miss — 'counterexample'/'inequality' do not overlap the tool name/description well; a fallback-to-triage case

cases.query: factor a whole number into its prime factors

do these premises logically entail the conclusion
independently check a certificate without trusting z3 or sympy
find the eigenvalues of a matrix
compute the indefinite integral of a function
grade a step by step solution and find the first wrong step

greatest common divisor of two integers
